sara (partnerships): FYI NVIDIA pushed driver 540.12 to their public repos and some partners are seeing perf/regressions on CUDA12.2. Marketplace images still reference 535 pins. Need quick plan for marketplace + partner channels. :eyes:
aj (eng): Thanks — can you share the failing perf signal? Is it latency p99 or throughput?
sara (partnerships): Mostly p99 token-latency spikes on long-context tests. A couple of customers flagged higher tail for decoder-only workloads. I attached repro artifacts in the partner portal link: https://partners.redwood/shares/driver-54012
beth (partner-eng): Can you paste the repro command here? I want to run on our staging infra.
sara (partnerships): repro: `python perf_run.py --model redwood-open-13b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --cuda 12.2` logs are in that bundle.
aj (eng): Ok I can repro locally. Quick mitigation: update marketplace AMI/container to pin driver 535.* for images used by marketplace deployments, and add a gate to prevent 540.* automated rollouts until we validate.
leo (hw-partner): NVIDIA team here — we saw a kernel reg that affects certain attention kernels on 540.12. We're validating a 540.14 candidate with micro-optimizations. ETA 48h for beta. If you need an immediate workaround we can ship a hotfix RPM with the old kernel paths.
tim (sre): Can we do a soft rollback on Dedicated fleets? We should avoid customer-facing downtime. Suggest a staged restart of nodes with pinned drivers plus `--fallback-kernel` flag in runtime.
aj (eng): Plan suggestion: 1) Marketplace: pin container to 535 and publish a stop-gap image (patch) 2) Dedicated: flag impacted pools and schedule non-disruptive rolling reprovision to 535 3) Private: inform customers/partners, offer hotfix RPM from vendor 4) Comm: coordinated note to marketplace customers + hw partners
olivia (pm): Prioritize customers on SLAs and those about to onboard. Draft comms for tomorrow morning. Do we have a short message to send partners now?
beth (partner-eng): Draft: "Heads-up: we've observed increased tail latency on 540.12 for some workloads. We're pinning marketplace images to 535 and working with NVIDIA on a hotfix. If you're on Dedicated/Private and want an expedited fix, reply here." Thoughts? :thumbsup:
leo (hw-partner): That wording is fine. We'll share 540.14 beta to your partner bucket when ready. Also sending a short changelog of kernel diffs.
deploy-bot: [alert] marketplace-image-build #1245 failed to push to prod registry at 2026-03-21T10:05Z (retrying)
aj (eng): Noted re: build failure — hold any automated promotion until we confirm pin. I'll open a quick PR to pin driver in the marketplace buildkite job: `env DRIVER_VERSION=535.*`
tim (sre): I'll create a runbook section for this — will add owner tags: `sre:oncall`, `eng:runtime`, `partner-eng`
sara (partnerships): Thanks all. Action items: aj -> PR to pin images (ETA 2h), tim -> runbook + pool flags (ETA 3h), beth -> coordinate partner comm & collect repro data (ETA 4h), leo -> share 540.14 beta (ETA 48h). We'll sync in 2h in #partnerships. :calendar:
